body:
The desktop port now draws original sprite texels with nearest sampling and reference encoded-RGB composition. A game-owned macOS adapter supplies reversible borderless fullscreen and continuous YM playback with pause/resume at the exact source cursor. The installed engine sources and binaries are unchanged.

The renderer preserves draw order and fits the board at native, wide and tall sizes. Editable UI documents retain labels and controls. Physical Escape, editor modifiers and focus-loss handling have regression coverage. Unique derived-WAV asset keys fix a YM/WAV alias collision; all 281 original asset hashes are preserved.

The packaged adapter runs the pinned original YM decoder continuously across loop boundaries. Initial controls precede output; mute preserves the cursor and defers track changes until unmute. Per-launch identity isolates ordinary editor Play worlds. Native transport failure restores the editor-compatible fallback until authenticated status confirms recovery; interrupted request bodies leave the bridge responsive. SFX stop on mute, retain per-cue volume, and use descending priorities to preserve Go’s reject-new behavior at the global 24-voice cap. Seven focused audio tests cover these policies, including actual mixer saturation controls.

Validation is local on macOS arm64, release V8/Metal:

- 93 T0 tests, 14 desktop T1 tests, four explicit-scene replays, typecheck/cook/600-frame smoke and asset provenance guard.
- Exact RGB/source-over probes and a rendered replay covering eleven pages plus combat effects: 170 sampled frames, peak 11 desktop draws against a budget of 14. The earlier all-tier structural route peaks at 11/9/9; this does not establish non-desktop RGB parity.
- Failure regressions: aborted HTTP body leaves the server responsive; actual controller probe covers 600 steps, five successful state ACKs and 187 status polls through repeated native failure and recovery.
- Independent original PCM comparisons for all five YM tracks across two loops plus tails; actual packaged transport continues beyond a loop, preserves cursor/hash through a 700 ms pause, resumes with exact PCM prefixes and resets on track change. Bounded queue, startup pause/mute, helper shutdown and launcher-loss cleanup checks pass.
- A clean export of final commit `d1d3078` passed `verify-full` in 39.539 s (93 T0, 14 T1, presentation route, all four replays and check). The latest warm fast verification took 30.620 s, slightly above the 30 s feedback target.

This PR remains a draft because the final native input-driven settings/fullscreen/focus integration check is blocked by the locked Mac. Transport and client-isolation checks do not substitute for that GUI gate. Do not merge before it passes.

Full Go pixel equality is not claimed: pristine Go captures vary at tile texel boundaries, and font rasterization remains scoped. The installed runtime drops three recorded built-in Standard warm-up entries despite their independently verified correct hash; loaded materials still warm their own pipelines. Hermes and hosted CI runtime distribution remain unavailable. Ordinary editor music uses the converted-WAV fallback. This developer launcher supports macOS arm64 and is not a notarized installer.
